svg.text: oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library - github.com/uxlfoundation/oneDNN - cross-platform CPU/GPU DNN primitives + Graph API
L1 - Framework Integration + Workloads (UXL Foundation - unified API for CPU and GPU inference/training)
L2 - Dual Programming Model (Primitive API low-level control - Graph API high-level partition fusion)
Auto fusion for inference on x86-64 (PT 2.0+)
engine = CPU or GPU device abstraction
stream = ordered execution queue on engine
reorder primitive for cross-engine layout xfer
Same API: x86 AMD64 AArch64 GPU SYCL
Runtime ISA detect + JIT for each target
L3 - API Surface (Graph concepts - Primitive descriptors - shared engine/stream)
logical_tensor: id dtype dims layout property
op: kind attrs in/out logical tensors
memory: buffer bound to memory_desc on engine
input/output ports via logical tensor IDs
output layout=any lets compiler pick optimal
dynamic shapes deduced at compile time
L4 - Graph Execution Pipeline (build graph - partition - compile to ISA - bind tensors - execute on stream)
Connect ops via shared logical tensor IDs
Library splits into fusible subgraph units
Lower to ISA binary - specialize layouts
Query output mem_size if layout was any
Framework maps partition back as custom node
L5 - Backend Implementations (CPU JIT dispatcher - Graph Compiler - GPU SYCL - AArch64 ACL)
Runtime ISA: SSE41 AVX2 AVX512 AMX
Intel iGPU dGPU Arc Max + exp NVIDIA AMD
OpenMP TBB or SYCL CPU runtime
L6 - Source Layout + Build (src/cpu/ - src/gpu/ - src/graph/ - CMake ISA/runtime toggles - UXL Foundation)
Graph Partition Execution Path (PyTorch 2.0+ oneDNN Graph backend on x86-64)
Framework exports FX/torch.compile graph - oneDNN partitions and fuses for CPU inference
Step 1: Framework builds graph ops - add logical tensors with strided or opaque layout
Step 2: graph.finalize() - get_partitions() returns fusible Conv+ReLU+BN subgraphs
Step 3: partition.compile(engine) - JIT to AVX512/AMX - pick blocked output layout
Step 4: Bind tensor data handles - query mem_size for any-layout outputs - alloc buffers
Step 5: compiled_partition.execute(stream) - fused kernel - fewer DRAM round-trips
Graph Compiler: aggressive MHA/MLP fusion via xbyak/LLVM codegen (AVX512_CORE min)
Primitive path: create primitive_desc - create primitive - execute on stream (manual fusion via post-ops)
CPU dispatcher: runtime detect highest ISA - dnnl::set_max_cpu_isa for debug/tuning
Open-source cross-vendor DNN primitive lib - CPU-first with growing GPU - UXL oneAPI spec
graph.add_op - finalize - get_partitions - compile - execute(stream, tensors)
Design Position (open cross-platform DNN primitive layer - partition fusion + JIT ISA dispatch for CPU inference peak)
Graph partition + runtime JIT + blocked layouts + AMX = default CPU backend for PyTorch/OpenVINO on Intel Xeon
Init: engine(stream) create - CPU ISA detect - optional set_max_cpu_isa - graph or primitive descriptor build
Loop: graph partition compile OR primitive execute - reorder if layout mismatch - stream ordered launch
